title: Kyle Rudolph’s $15M Minnesota mansion heads to auction
summary_full: A lavish mansion in Minnesota, previously owned by NFL star Kyle Rudolph, is set to be auctioned off after failing to attract buyers. Originally priced at $14.95 million, the estate is now being offered for co-ownership, with six shares available starting at $1.55 million each. Interested parties can tour the residence before the auction date of December 10, presenting a unique chance to invest in luxury real estate.
